get_colormap_bgr: get a numpy array of 88 distinct BGR colors scaled to 0-255 for visualization
get_colormap_rgb: get a numpy array of 88 distinct RGB colors scaled to 0-255 for visualization
color_segmentation_masks: color segmentation masks by indexing into the colormap array with class labels
visualize_detection_boxes: visualize detection boxes by assigning unique colors from the colormap to each class
review_colormap_function: review the colormap function that returns 88 distinct colors in RGB or BGR format
